name: Nibango
oneLiner: A local marketplace to buy, sell, bid and give away near you, with groups for your area and your interests. Zero commission.

name: Curb
oneLiner: Track all your subscriptions in one place. Know exactly what you’re paying, when, and cancel what you don’t need.

name: Raved
oneLiner: An inbox for recommendations. Save every film, show, book, album, podcast and place your friends rave about, and actually get to them.

name: Blab
oneLiner: A small social network for saying what you think, in worlds of people who share your interests. One daily challenge for everyone.
